name: Audio Leveler
author: G-Hancox
description: Makes every song in your show play at the same loudness, while songs meant to sit under the show stay there. Measures each song (EBU R128 loudness and true peak) and recommends the gentlest fix: a plain volume change when that's enough (through FPP's own Normalize where FPP has it, or a lossless MP3Gain-style change), and a gentle true-peak limiter only when a song's peaks need it. You can pick a different fix per song: volume only, limiter, light compression, Background (deliberately under the show, for ambiance) or Skip. File names and timing are kept, so sequences stay in sync. Levels the sound of videos too, without touching the picture, and can level new and re-uploaded songs automatically. Originals are backed up for one-click restore, and work waits until no show is playing. Runs entirely on this device using ffmpeg.

privacy.summary: Runs on this device only. Levels the songs and video soundtracks you choose (or new uploads, if switched on) through FPP's Normalize or by rewriting the file, keeping backups.

collects.what: Backup copies of the songs and videos you level, and their loudness measurements

systemChanges.what: Replaces songs and videos with leveled versions when you level them, or new uploads if switched on. Video pictures are untouched. Originals backed up.
On FPP versions with File Manager > Normalize, volume-only fixes are set through FPP's Normalize (a per-song playback gain) instead of in the file.
